problem_statement: Zephyr lacks a generic GPIO controller for an external latch-backed, memory-mapped output port (e.g. a 74HC574 latched onto an FMC bank). Such a device should be usable through the standard GPIO API as an output-only controller with 8/16/32-bit register width and a configurable number of valid lines (ngpios). Because the latch may be write-only with no hardware readback, the driver must keep a software shadow of the last output value and expose it through readback. It must support masked writes that touch only the requested bits, set/clear/toggle of bits, configuration of a pin as output with an initial high or low level that updates the shadow, an initial-output value written to the latch at init, and rejection of unsupported configurations (input, pull-up/pull-down, open-drain, single-ended). Invalid pins and flag combinations must return errors.
